intro: Write what responders should know and choose, field by field, what is shown. Only shared fields are ever sent to someone who opens your card.
shareToggle: Show this field on the emergency card

preview.title: What others will see
preview.hint: Updates as you type. Only shown fields appear.

qr.title: QR code
qr.body: Anyone signed in to Pulse who scans this sees your emergency card, and you are notified each time. Print it or keep it on your phone.
qr.alt: QR code that opens your emergency card
qr.rotateHint: Replacing or turning off stops every printed copy working immediately.

scan.body: Scan someone's Pulse emergency QR code to open their emergency card. The scan is recorded and they are notified.
scan.cameraDenied: Camera is unavailable. Paste the link below instead.
scan.manual: Or paste the link or code
scan.invalid: That is not a Pulse emergency code.

view.title: Emergency card
view.audited: This view is recorded and the patient is notified.
view.nothingShared: This patient has not shared any emergency details.

notFound.title: Card not available
notFound.body: The code is invalid, was replaced, or you do not have access.
